law_name: Cabinet Office Order on Certified Association for Payment Service Providers
law_name_original: Cabinet Office Order on Certified Association for Payment Service Providers
text_en: The terms "issuer of prepaid payment instruments", "funds transfer services", "cryptoasset exchange services", and "certified association for payment service providers" as used in this Cabinet Office Order mean issuer of prepaid payment instruments, funds transfer services, cryptoasset exchange services, and certified association for payment service providers as prescribed in Article 2 of the (hereinafter referred to as the "Act"), respectively.

text_en:
Article 3. (Public Inspection of Membership List)

A certified association for payment service providers is to keep its membership list at its office and make it available for public inspection.
